searchQueries.title: Search queries
searchQueries.description: Steam store search terms, e.g. ["hades", "co-op roguelike", "factorio"]. Each result is enriched with full app details.

appIds.title: App IDs / URLs
appIds.description: Specific Steam app IDs or store URLs to fetch, e.g. [1145360, "https://store.steampowered.com/app/570/Dota_2/"]. Use alone or with searchQueries.

includeReviews.title: Include reviews
includeReviews.description: Also fetch player reviews for each app (cursor-paginated).

maxReviewsPerApp.title: Max reviews per app
maxReviewsPerApp.description: Cap on reviews collected per app (100 per page).

reviewFilter.title: Review filter
reviewFilter.description: Which reviews: recent (default), updated, or all.

reviewLanguage.title: Review language
reviewLanguage.description: Language code for reviews, e.g. all (default), english, german, spanish.

reviewPurchaseType.title: Review purchase type
reviewPurchaseType.description: all (default), steam (purchased on Steam) or non_steam_purchase.

includeDescriptions.title: Include full descriptions
includeDescriptions.description: Include the long detailed/about descriptions (adds sizeable text to each game row).

country.title: Country (store region)
country.description: Two-letter store region for pricing, e.g. US, GB, DE.

language.title: Language
language.description: Store language for names/descriptions, e.g. english, german.

maxResultsPerSearch.title: Max results per search
maxResultsPerSearch.description: Cap on games collected per search term.

maxItems.title: Max rows total
maxItems.description: Overall cap on rows (games + reviews) pushed to the dataset.
